items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And what's your name? Herb Friedwald. Well, my name is Dick Allen...

ctx.x: Emil Barnes. Some call me middle, short name, you know. But I'm well known by Emil Barnes.

And what's your name? Herb Friedwald. Well, my name is Dick Allen and let's see, we're recording today at 3610 Metropolitan Street. It's January the 3rd, 1962. Okay, Herbie, you want to ask me something?

Well, I wanted to ask Emil about some of the clarinet players that you don't hear too much about now that he knows. The different ones that played with Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly and those guys way back. Not the clarinet players that would be known as reading musicians, but some of the other ones.
